title: Turkish Lamb Lahmacun
description: A delicious, oven-roasted Turkish dish featuring juicy lamb, flavorful spices, and a sweet golden syrup. Perfect for a post-workout meal.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless, preferably with a slight fat layer

ingredients.name: Lahmacun spice mix
ingredients.notes: store-bought or homemade mix of paprika, cumin, garlic powder, and salt

ingredients.name: Golden syrup
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a mixture of equal parts honey and pomegranate molasses

instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder under cold water, pat it dry with paper towels, and season with salt, black pepper, and crushed red pepper flakes.
In a large bowl, mix together the lahmacun spice mix, golden syrup, chopped parsley, and chopped mint.
Add the sliced red onion to the bowl and toss to combine.
Place the lamb shoulder in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe skillet with a tight-fitting lid.
Pour the spice mixture over the lamb, making sure to coat it evenly.
Cover the Dutch oven or skillet with a lid and place it in the preheated oven.
Roast the lamb for 2.5 hours, or until it reaches your desired level of tenderness.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the lamb with the roasted onions and a drizzle of the pan juices.
